data.one_liner: A flexible Gantt chart widget with drag-and-drop, task resizing, and timeline zooming.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance Gantt chart widget for Flutter that supports interactive task creation, drag-and-drop moving, resizing, and dependency visualization. It features offline support with CRDT synchronization and timeline navigation.
use_when: You need to display project schedules or timelines with interactive tasks.
Users need to drag and drop tasks or adjust timelines in real time.
You require offline-first synchronization using Hybrid Logical Clocks.
avoid_when: You only need standard line, bar, or pie charts.
Your project does not involve date-based scheduling or project management.
strengths: Supports over 10,000 tasks efficiently using CustomPainter.
Interactive drag-and-drop, resizing, and dependency management.
Built-in offline synchronization and conflict detection.
weaknesses: Large dependency footprint including SQLite and web socket packages.
Complex state model when configuring advanced synchronization.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade charts backed by Syncfusion.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need lightweight, highly customizable standard charts without heavy project management overhead.
